passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I have a pet, and it is a dog.
phrases.py: wǒ yǒu yī zhī chǒng wù， tā shì gǒu。

phrases.zh: 可可很小，而且是棕色的。
phrases.py: kě kě hěn xiǎo， ér qiě shì zōng sè de。

phrases.en: He waits at the door when I come home.
phrases.ko: 내가 집에 오면 코코는 문 앞에서 기다려요.
phrases.zh: 我回家的时候，它在门口等我。
phrases.py: wǒ huí jiā de shí hòu， tā zài mén kǒu děng wǒ。

phrases.en: I love my pet because he is gentle.
phrases.zh: 我爱我的宠物，因为它很温和。
phrases.py: wǒ ài wǒ de chǒng wù， yīn wèi tā hěn wēn hé。

phrases.en: My little sister likes his name.
phrases.py: mèi mèi xǐ huān tā de míng zì。

phrases.en: A small brown dog can be a big friend.
phrases.ko: 작고 갈색인 개도 큰 친구가 될 수 있어요.
phrases.zh: 一只小棕狗也可以是很好的朋友。
phrases.py: yī zhī xiǎo zōng gǒu yě kě yǐ shì hěn hǎo de péng yǒu。

phrases.en: We run in the park with the ball.
phrases.zh: 我们带着球在公园里跑。
phrases.py: wǒ men dài zhe qiú zài gōng yuán lǐ pǎo。

phrases.en: I feed him, and then he sits by the door.
phrases.ko: 내가 먹이를 주면 코코는 문 옆에 앉아요.
phrases.zh: 我喂它，然后它坐在门边。
phrases.py: wǒ wèi tā， rán hòu tā zuò zài mén biān。

full_passage_spoken: I have a pet, and it is a dog. His name is Coco. Coco is small and brown. He runs with a ball. I feed him every day. He waits at the door when I come home. I love my pet because he is gentle. My little sister likes his name. A small brown dog can be a big friend. We run in the park with the ball. I feed him, and then he sits by the door.
full_passage_zh: 我有一只宠物，它是狗。它叫可可。可可很小，而且是棕色的。它带着球跑。我每天喂它。我回家的时候，它在门口等我。我爱我的宠物，因为它很温和。妹妹喜欢它的名字。一只小棕狗也可以是很好的朋友。我们带着球在公园里跑。我喂它，然后它坐在门边。
